error[L0102]: this line begins with `[`, which continues the line above as an index, and an index is never empty
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/line-leading-bracket-continues-as-an-index/program.ldn:11:9
   |
11 |         []
   |         ^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/line-leading-bracket-continues-as-an-index/program.ldn:10:13
   |
10 |         _ = e
   |             ^ the line above ends with this
  = note: [1750]: a line end ends no statement; to begin a value with `[`, write the value that ends the line above in parentheses, as `(name)`, so nothing indexes it
